name: TMPlayer for Apple
subtitle: Your Telegram videos on iPhone and iPad.
description: TMPlayer for Apple is a free, open source, unofficial Telegram media player that plays the videos in your own Telegram chats on iPhone and iPad, while they are still downloading. Not affiliated with Telegram.

apps.name: TMPlayer for Apple
apps.subtitle: Your Telegram videos, playing before the download finishes.
apps.localizedDescription:
TMPlayer for Apple plays the videos in your own Telegram chats and channels on iPhone and iPad. It starts within seconds while the file is still downloading, and seeking moves the download to the new spot.

Sign in with your Telegram account, pick a chat, and only its playable videos appear: no messages, no server, no account except yours. Subtitles and audio tracks, episodes recognised from file names, Continue watching, Favourites and downloads, as TMPlayer has them on Android.

Unofficial, not affiliated with Telegram. Free and open source under the GPL 3.0, based on TMPlayer by dracu-lah.

versions.localizedDescription:
- A video with sound in more than one language now plays one language at a time and lists them
  all, with all of its subtitles, as on Android. Some MP4 files played two languages over each
  other and listed only one.
- "TMPlayer is struggling on this device" no longer appears when it is other apps that fill the
  device's memory.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: TMPlayer saves the videos and frames you choose to Photos.
